name: wwp-film-workflow
description: Repo-local Codex skills and helpers for WWP film and series production workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Produce WWP playable video, Notion pages, Media Assets, and metadata.
interface.longDescription: Project-local Codex workflow rules for selecting films and series, creating work/spec pages early, encoding playable MP4 variants, publishing to Notion, writing Media Assets, backfilling manual uploads, handling source archives, and filling structured film metadata through identity, Douban, OMDb, TMDb, and AI advisory lanes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the WWP film workflow to evaluate a user-specified input directory, produce playable versions, publish to Notion, and verify Media Assets.
